name: Review forestry map ground-control residuals
objective: Prepare a legacy forestry map registration for reviewer acceptance.
initial_test: Read fresh dX[pixels] and dY[pixels] for the exercise map control points; flag residuals exceeding the exercise-specific 10-pixel criterion and check coordinate transcription.
exit_predicate: After correction, every reviewed absolute dX and dY is at most 10 pixels, control-point identities and CRS are confirmed, and a cartographer accepts the overlay comparison; not a universal mapping accuracy claim.

procedure.operate_step: Propose one correction to a demonstrably mis-digitized control point or transcribed coordinate, for a cartographer to approve on a working copy; preserve the reference values and prior residuals.
procedure.retest: Recompute the control-point residual table from the changed working copy and compare the registered map with its reference aerial image; do not reuse the old residuals.
stop_conditions: Exit only when the fresh retest satisfies the exit predicate; preserve the before/after evidence.
Stop unresolved on missing evidence, missing authorization, no measurable progress, oscillation, or exhausted author-policy iteration budget.

name: Resolve reviewed polygon overlap findings
objective: Bring a thematic polygon coverage into conformance with an approved no-overlap rule without erasing legitimate features.
initial_test: Run full-layer topology validation using the reviewer-approved Must not overlap rule; retain feature IDs and inspect flagged common areas against the authoritative reference.
exit_predicate: A fresh full-layer validation reports zero overlaps under the same approved rule, and a cartographer confirms the corrections preserve the intended boundaries; no claim of legal boundary accuracy.

procedure.operate_step: For one confirmed erroneous overlap, propose a boundary edit on a copy using the authoritative map evidence; a cartographer must approve edits, not automatic deletion of every flagged feature.
procedure.retest: Apply the same active rule to all features again after the approved edit and review the new error table, including previously edited neighbors.
stop_conditions: Exit only when the fresh retest satisfies the exit predicate; preserve the before/after evidence.
Stop unresolved on missing evidence, missing authorization, no measurable progress, oscillation, or exhausted author-policy iteration budget.

name: Review a statistical process-control signal
objective: Resolve a reviewed chart signal using documentary evidence and an approved corrective-action plan.
initial_test: Inspect a valid chart with approved fixed control limits and predeclared nonrandom-pattern rules; flag an outside-limit point or systematic pattern.
exit_predicate: Fresh samples over a quality-engineer-defined verification window show no outside-limit points or signals under the same approved pattern rules; documented cause disposition is accepted by the engineer. This does not certify product conformance.

procedure.operate_step: Investigate the suspected assignable cause and draft one evidence-supported corrective-action request for qualified review; this research specification gives no machine adjustment or shop-floor command.
procedure.retest: After separately authorized corrective work, chart newly collected samples under the approved sampling plan and test the same limits and nonrandom-pattern rules; do not merely relabel old points.
stop_conditions: Exit only when the fresh retest satisfies the exit predicate; preserve the before/after evidence.
Stop unresolved on missing evidence, missing authorization, no measurable progress, oscillation, or exhausted author-policy iteration budget.

name: Review stable but off-target process performance
objective: Prepare and assess a reviewed improvement proposal for a stable but unacceptable process.
initial_test: First confirm stability using the approved control-chart plan; compare the documented process level and variability with separately approved target and acceptance limits. Enter only if stable but unacceptable.
exit_predicate: New post-intervention data remain stable and meet the preapproved target/variation criteria over the approved verification window, with quality-engineer sign-off; missing specification or stability evidence is unresolved, not success.

procedure.operate_step: Choose one documented improvement proposal (experimental study, calibration review, or historical-data re-analysis) for quality-engineer approval. Do not perform calibration or prescribe process settings in this research artifact.
procedure.retest: After any separately approved intervention, collect independent fresh observations, check stability first, then recompare level and variability with the unchanged approved target criteria.
stop_conditions: Exit only when the fresh retest satisfies the exit predicate; preserve the before/after evidence.
Stop unresolved on missing evidence, missing authorization, no measurable progress, oscillation, or exhausted author-policy iteration budget.

name: Review a museum collection microclimate deviation
objective: Assess whether a reviewed non-mechanical preservation change restores approved temperature/RH conditions.
initial_test: Review calibrated logger records and contextual observations against conservator-approved temperature/RH setpoints, permissible fluctuations and a declared assessment window; identify a persistent deviation.
exit_predicate: Fresh logger records for the agreed post-change window are stable and within the approved setpoint ranges, with conservator acceptance; close this corrective episode only, not ongoing monitoring.

procedure.operate_step: Prepare one evidence-based non-mechanical climate-control proposal for the qualified museum team; the team decides and separately authorizes any implementation. No HVAC work, hazardous materials treatment, or object relocation is instructed here.
procedure.retest: After an approved change, review newly recorded logger data with matched locations and contextual notes, comparing against the same approved ranges and baseline.
stop_conditions: Exit only when the fresh retest satisfies the exit predicate; preserve the before/after evidence.
Stop unresolved on missing evidence, missing authorization, no measurable progress, oscillation, or exhausted author-policy iteration budget.

name: Review the effectiveness of a collection lighting plan
objective: Assess whether a reviewed lighting-protection change meets collection-specific exposure criteria.
initial_test: Review baseline visible-light, UV, heat and exposure-duration records at declared monitoring sites against conservator-approved material-specific criteria; flag a deviation or unverified filter performance.
exit_predicate: Fresh before/after-comparable site records satisfy all approved visible-light, UV, heat and exposure-duration criteria, and the conservator accepts effectiveness; ongoing exposure monitoring continues.

procedure.operate_step: Prepare one lighting-improvement-plan revision for conservator and facilities review, such as a documented reduction in exposure duration. Any installation, electrical work or handling of collection objects is outside this specification.
procedure.retest: After separate approval/implementation, obtain new comparable readings from the same declared sites and assess the approved exposure schedule; retain the before/after Light and Heat Measurement Record.
stop_conditions: Exit only when the fresh retest satisfies the exit predicate; preserve the before/after evidence.
Stop unresolved on missing evidence, missing authorization, no measurable progress, oscillation, or exhausted author-policy iteration budget.
